anomalies.message: CPU load average is significantly high across all intervals, indicating potential overutilization or bottleneck.
AI system has not generated any learning cycles or opportunities, suggesting it might be inactive or malfunctioning.
Trading system shows zero active trades and a win rate of 0, which is unusual for a trading platform.

optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU usage to prevent potential performance degradation.
Review and potentially restart AI processes to ensure they are functioning correctly.
Evaluate trading strategies and system configurations to ensure they are correctly set up and operational.

recommendations.action: Immediately investigate the cause of high CPU load and take corrective actions such as load balancing or scaling resources.
recommendations.rationale: High CPU load can lead to system instability and affect trading operations, requiring urgent attention.

recommendations.action: Restart or debug the AI system to ensure it is actively learning and generating opportunities.
recommendations.rationale: AI inactivity can lead to missed trading opportunities and reduced platform effectiveness.

recommendations.action: Conduct a review of trading strategies and system configurations to ensure they are correctly implemented and aligned with market conditions.
recommendations.rationale: Zero active trades and win rate may indicate misconfiguration or strategy misalignment.
